## Necessary Packages and Dataset Import

```{r}
#packages
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(skimr)
library(margins)
library(detectseparation)
library(car)
library(modelsummary)
library(tidyverse)
library(performance)
library(psych)
library(mokken)
library(haven)
library(expss)
library(naniar)
library(broom)
library(rio)
library(ggResidpanel)
library(mice)
library(flextable)
library(marginaleffects)
library(pROC)

#Dataset Import
EB86 <- import("../data/ZA6788_v2-0-0.dta")

```

## Variables

```{r}
#Variable Coding

#CSDP Support
EB86 <- EB86 |>
  mutate(csdp_support = dplyr::recode(as.numeric(qa17_4), 
                          `2` = 0, 
                          `3` = NA_real_, 
                          `9` = NA_real_))

# US favourability (With neutral category)
EB86 <- EB86 |>  
  mutate(us_favourability = case_when(
    as.numeric(d73a_3) == 1 ~ 1,
    as.numeric(d73a_3) == 2 ~ -1,
    as.numeric(d73a_3) == 3 ~ 0,
    as.numeric(d73a_3) %in% c(4, 9) ~ NA_real_
  ) |> 
  factor(levels = c(0, 1, -1), labels = c("Neutral", "Positive", "Negative")))

# US Favourability as continous likert scale
EB86 <- EB86 |>
  mutate(us_favourability_likert = case_when(
    as.numeric(d73a_3) == 1 ~ 3,  # Positive -> 3
    as.numeric(d73a_3) == 2 ~ 1,  # Negative -> 1
    as.numeric(d73a_3) == 3 ~ 2,  # Neutral -> 2
    as.numeric(d73a_3) %in% c(4, 9) ~ NA_real_  # Missing values
  ))

#list of countries historically attacked/occpied by Soviet Union


historical_threat_RU <- c("PL", "LT", "LV", "EE", "FI",  "CZ", "SK", "HU", "RO", "BG", "DE-E")

EB86$historical_threat_RU <- ifelse(EB86$isocntry %in% historical_threat_RU, 1, 0)


EB86$historical_threat_RU <- factor(EB86$historical_threat_RU,
                                    levels = c(0, 1),
                                    labels = c("No Threat", "Threat"))

#adding identity

EB86 <- EB86 |>
  mutate(
    nat_id = case_when(
      qd1a_2 == 1 | qd1a_2 == 2 ~ 1,
      qd1a_2 == 3 | qd1a_2 == 4 ~ 0,
      qd1a_2 == 5 | qd1a_2 == 9 ~ NA_real_))

EB86 <- EB86 |>
  mutate(
    eu_id = case_when(
      qd1a_4 == 1 | qd1a_4 == 2 ~ 1,
      qd1a_4 == 3 | qd1a_4 == 4 ~ 0,
      qd1a_4 == 5 | qd1a_4 == 9 ~ NA_real_))


#creating dummy vars for exclusive and inclusive ID

EB86 <- EB86 |>
  mutate(
    inclusive_id_dummy = factor(
      ifelse(eu_id == 1 & nat_id == 0 | eu_id == 1 & nat_id == 1, 1, 0),
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Not Inclusive", "Inclusive")
    ),
    exclusive_id_dummy = factor(
      ifelse(eu_id == 0 & nat_id == 1, 1, 0),
      levels = c(0, 1),
      labels = c("Not Exclusive", "Exclusive")))

#sophistication (corect answers out of 3 about EU)
#coding may be kept as is: 3 point scale with 1 = bad, 2= avg, 3 = good knowledge of eu

#Age

EB86 <- EB86|> 
  mutate(Age = as.numeric(d11))

#globalisation attitude (because anti-americanism linked to anti-capitalism)

EB86 <- EB86|>
  mutate(global_capitalism = case_when(
    qa10_2 == 1 ~ 1,  # positive = 1
    qa10_2 == 2 ~ 1,  # positive = 1
    qa10_2 == 3 ~ 0,  # negative = 0
    qa10_2 == 4 ~ 0,  # another negative = 0
    qa10_2 == 5 ~ NA_real_  # don't know = NA
  )) %>%
  mutate(global_capitalism = as.factor(global_capitalism),  # Convert to factor
         global_capitalism = relevel(global_capitalism, ref = "1"))  # Set positive as reference


# cultural anti-ameircanism: coutnires explciitl mentioned in ltierature as having positive or negative collective memories of intractions with the US

neg_us_memory <- c("FR", "ES", "PT", "GR", "DE-E", "CY", "SI", "LU")

# Add indicator to dataset based on isocntry variable
EB86$cultural_anti_am <- factor(ifelse(EB86$isocntry %in% neg_us_memory, 1, 0), 
                                levels = c(0, 1), 
                                labels = c("Neutral", "Negative"))



#Political Trust Index
#recoding component items
EB86 <- EB86 |> 
  mutate(judiciary_trust = case_when(
    as.numeric(qa8a_6) == 2 ~ 0,  
    as.numeric(qa8a_6) %in% c(3, 9) ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(qa8a_6)
  )) 

EB86 <- EB86 |> 
  mutate(party_trust = case_when(
    as.numeric(qa8a_10) == 2 ~ 0,  
    as.numeric(qa8a_10) %in% c(3, 9) ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(qa8a_10)
  )) 

EB86 <- EB86 |> 
  mutate(government_trust = case_when(
    as.numeric(qa8a_12) == 2 ~ 0,  
    as.numeric(qa8a_12) %in% c(3, 9) ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(qa8a_12)
  )) 

EB86 <- EB86 |> 
  mutate(parliament_trust = case_when(
    as.numeric(qa8a_13) == 2 ~ 0,  
    as.numeric(qa8a_13) %in% c(3, 9) ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(qa8a_13)
  )) 

EB86 <- EB86 |> 
  mutate(UN_trust = case_when(
    as.numeric(qa8a_15) == 2 ~ 0,  
    as.numeric(qa8a_15) %in% c(3, 9) ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ as.numeric(qa8a_15)
  ))

#Perform MSA to see if scale is acceptable
#check monotonicity
monotonicity_check_inst_trust <- check.monotonicity(EB86 |> dplyr::select(judiciary_trust, party_trust, government_trust, parliament_trust, UN_trust)|> filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.))))


plot(monotonicity_check_inst_trust)
summary(monotonicity_check_inst_trust)

#select items
institutional_trust_Automated_Item_Selection_Procedure <- aisp(EB86 |> dplyr::select(judiciary_trust, party_trust, government_trust, parliament_trust, UN_trust)|> filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.))), verbose = TRUE, )

print(institutional_trust_Automated_Item_Selection_Procedure)

#check invaraint item ordering
institutional_trust_invariable_item_ordering_check <- check.iio(EB86 |> dplyr::select(judiciary_trust, party_trust, government_trust, parliament_trust, UN_trust)|> filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.))), item.selection = TRUE, verbose = TRUE, fixed.item.order = TRUE)

print(institutional_trust_invariable_item_ordering_check)

#check scalability coefficeints
institutional_trust_scalability_coefficients <- coefH(EB86 |> dplyr::select(judiciary_trust, party_trust, government_trust, parliament_trust, UN_trust)|> filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.))), se = TRUE, ci = TRUE, fixed.itemstep.order = TRUE)

print(institutional_trust_scalability_coefficients)


#final reliability check

inst_trust_reliability_check <- check.reliability(EB86 |> dplyr::select(judiciary_trust, party_trust, government_trust, parliament_trust, UN_trust)|> filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.))), MS = TRUE, alpha = TRUE, lambda.2 = TRUE, LCRC = TRUE, irc = TRUE)

print(inst_trust_reliability_check)

#Mokken anal sucessful, good scale, now construct:

trust_items_EB86 <- c("judiciary_trust", "party_trust", "government_trust", "parliament_trust", "UN_trust")

inst_trust_score <- rowMeans(EB86[, c("judiciary_trust", "party_trust", "government_trust", "parliament_trust", "UN_trust")], na.rm = TRUE)

EB86$inst_trust <- rowSums(EB86[, trust_items_EB86], na.rm = TRUE) / 5

```

## Investigating N/A & Trimming Dataset

```{r}

#select relevant columns & filter non-eu & non-nato states
EB86_selected <- EB86 |>
  filter(p1 >= 7)|> #Filters out any observations taken before Wedneday 9th November (7th day of fieldwork)
  filter(isocntry %in% c(
  "BE", "BG", "HR", "CZ", "DK", "EE", "FR", 
  "DE-E","DE-W", "GR", "HU", "IT", "LV", "LT", "LU", "NL", 
  "PL", "PT", "RO", "SK", "SI", "ES", "GB-GBN"
)) |>
  dplyr::select(csdp_support, us_favourability_likert, us_favourability,  historical_threat_RU,
   inclusive_id_dummy, exclusive_id_dummy, Age, euknowl,
                global_capitalism, cultural_anti_am, inst_trust,isocntry,)

gg_miss_fct(x = EB86_selected, fct = isocntry)

#checking distribution of incomeplte cases ranomness:



#removing all n/a, listwise deletion of incomeplete cases

EB86_selected_clean <- EB86_selected |>
  drop_na()

gg_miss_fct(x = EB86_selected_clean, fct = isocntry)

joint_eu_nato_ms <- c(
  "BE", "BG", "HR", "CZ", "DK", "EE", "FR", 
  "DE-E","DE-W", "GR", "HU", "IT", "LV", "LT", "LU", "NL", 
  "PL", "PT", "RO", "SK", "SI", "ES", "GB-GBN")

```

## Models (New)

```{r}

#Basic Model

reg2_bivar <- glm(`csdp_support` ~ `us_favourability_likert`, data = EB86_selected_clean, family = "binomial")

r2_nagelkerke(reg2_bivar)
modelsummary(reg2_bivar, stars = TRUE)

#Basic model with controls

reg2_controls <- glm(`csdp_support` ~ `us_favourability_likert`+`Age`+`inst_trust`+`global_capitalism`+`cultural_anti_am`+`euknowl`+`historical_threat_RU`+`inclusive_id_dummy`, data = EB86_selected_clean, family = "binomial")

r2_nagelkerke(reg2_controls)
modelsummary(reg2_controls, stars = TRUE)

#Identity interaction

reg2_identity <- glm(`csdp_support` ~ `us_favourability_likert`*`exclusive_id_dummy`, data = EB86_selected_clean, family = "binomial")

r2_nagelkerke(reg2_identity)
modelsummary(reg2_identity, stars = TRUE)


#Identity interaction controls

reg2_identity_controls <- glm(`csdp_support` ~ `us_favourability_likert`*`exclusive_id_dummy`
+`Age`+`inst_trust`+`global_capitalism`+`cultural_anti_am`+`euknowl`+`historical_threat_RU`+`inclusive_id_dummy`, data = EB86_selected_clean, family = "binomial")

r2_nagelkerke(reg2_identity_controls)
modelsummary(reg2_identity_controls, stars = TRUE)

#Fixed effects Identity interaction

reg2_identity_fe <- glm(`csdp_support` ~ `us_favourability_likert`*
  `exclusive_id_dummy`+
`Age`+`euknowl`+`global_capitalism`+`inst_trust` +`inclusive_id_dummy`
  + factor(isocntry) # Country fixed effects
  , data = EB86_selected_clean, family = "binomial",na.action = na.omit)

r2_nagelkerke(reg2_identity_fe)
modelsummary(reg2_identity_fe, stars = TRUE)

```

## Model Comparison 

```{r}
anova(reg2_bivar, reg2_controls,reg2_identity, reg2_identity_controls,reg2_identity_fe, test = "LRT")

AIC(reg2_bivar, reg2_controls,reg2_identity, reg2_identity_controls,reg2_identity_fe)


```

## Presentation

```{r}
reg_list_new <- list(
  reg2_bivar, reg2_controls,reg2_identity, reg2_identity_controls,reg2_identity_fe)



#Odds ratio table
modelsummary(
  reg_list_new,
  stars = TRUE,
  coef_rename = c(
    "(Intercept)" = "Constant",
   "us_favourability_likert" = "Attitude Toward US",
                       "us_favourability_likert:exclusive_id_dummyExclusive" = "US Attitude * Exclusive Identity Interaction",
                       "inst_trust" = "Latent Political Trust",
                       "global_capitalism0" = "Negative Attitude Towards Globalisation",
                       "cultural_anti_amNegative" = "Anti-American Culture",
                       "age" = "Age",
                       "historical_threat_RUThreat" = "Historically Threatened by Russia",
                       "euknowl" = "Respondent Sophistication",
                       "inclusive_id_dummyInclusive" = "Inclusive Identity",
                       "exclusive_id_dummyExclusive" = "Exclusive Identity"
  ),
  gof_map = c("nobs", "logLik"),
  exponentiate = TRUE, # Converts log-odds to odds ratios
  title = "CSDP Support",
  notes = "Odds ratios with standard errors in parentheses",
  model_order = 1:5,# adjusts model order
  model_names = c("Model 1", "Model 2", "Model 3", "Model 4", "Model 5"))

#To make into docx output, add: ,output = "LogitRegTableBAPv1.docx"


# reg2_identity_controls odds ratio plot data
reg2_identity_controls_odds_data <- tidy(reg2_identity_controls, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |> 
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept for clarity

# adding variable labels
reg2_identity_controls_odds_data <- reg2_identity_controls_odds_data |> 
  mutate(significant = ifelse(conf.low > 1 | conf.high < 1, "Significant", "Not Significant"))|>
  mutate(term = dplyr::recode(term,
                       "us_favourability_likert" = "Attitude Toward US",
                       "us_favourability_likert:exclusive_id_dummyExclusive" = "US Attitude * Exclusive Identity Interaction",
                       "inst_trust" = "Latent Political Trust",
                       "global_capitalism0" = "Negative Attitude Towards Globalisation",
                       "cultural_anti_amNegative" = "Anti-American Culture",
                       "age" = "Age",
                       "historical_threat_RUThreat" = "Historically Threatened by Russia",
                       "euknowl" = "Respondent Sophistication",
                       "inclusive_id_dummyInclusive" = "Inclusive Identity",
                       "exclusive_id_dummyExclusive" = "Exclusive Identity"))



ggplot(reg2_identity_controls_odds_data, aes(x = reorder(term, estimate), y = estimate, color = significant)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, aes(shape = significant)) +  # Shapes and colors for significance
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Odds Ratios with 95% Confidence Intervals",
    x = "",
    y = "Odds Ratio (Log Scale)"
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +  # Log scale for easier interpretation
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "black")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Significant" = 16, "Not Significant" = 17)) +  # Different point shapes
  theme_light(base_size = 19) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())  

#Predicted proability of CSDP support by identitiy configuration

#factor variable version of Identity_control model

reg2_identity_controls_factor <- glm(`csdp_support` ~ `us_favourability`*`exclusive_id_dummy`
+`Age`+`inst_trust`+`global_capitalism`+`cultural_anti_am`+`euknowl`+`historical_threat_RU`+`inclusive_id_dummy`, data = EB86_selected_clean, family = "binomial")

predictions(
  reg2_identity_controls_factor, 
  by = c("us_favourability", "exclusive_id_dummy"), 
  newdata = "mean"
) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = exclusive_id_dummy, y = estimate, shape = us_favourability, color = us_favourability)) + 
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) + 
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(estimate, 2)), 
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), 
    hjust = -0.3  # Adjust the label alignment to prevent overlap and align it with the points
  ) + 
  labs(
    title = "Predicted CSDP Support by US Attitude and Identity Configuration", 
    x = "Identity Configuration", 
    y = "Predicted CSDP Support", 
    shape = "US Attitude",
    color = "US Attitude"
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.8, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Negative" = "red", "Neutral" = "black", "Positive" = "blue")) + 
  theme_light()  # Apply a light theme for a clean background

#likert variable version of Identity_control model

reg2_identity_controls_preds <- predictions(reg2_identity_controls, 
            newdata = datagrid(us_favourability_likert = c(1,2,3), 
                               exclusive_id_dummy = c("Not Exclusive", "Exclusive")))

ggplot(reg2_identity_controls_preds, aes(x = us_favourability_likert, y = estimate, linetype = exclusive_id_dummy)) + 
  geom_line(aes(color = exclusive_id_dummy)) +  # Apply color to the lines only
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), alpha = 0.2) +  # No color for the ribbon
  labs(
    title = "Predicted CSDP Support by US Attitude and Identity Configuration", 
    x = "US Attitude", 
    y = "Predicted Values", 
    linetype = "Identity Configuration"
  ) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2, 3)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) + # Color lines red and blue
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "dashed")) + # Line styles
  theme_light() +  # Apply light theme
  guides(color = guide_legend(title = "Identity Configuration"), 
         linetype = guide_legend(title = "Identity Configuration"))  # Combine legends


```

## Assumptions Testing (New)

```{r}

#Multicollinearity

#vif(reg2_bivar)
vif(reg2_identity)
vif(reg2_identity_controls)
vif(reg2_identity_fe)


#linearity of logit



#identifying continuous predictors
sapply(EB86_selected_clean, class)

#reg2_bivar

EB86_selected_clean_reg2_bivar <- augment(reg2_bivar, data = EB86_selected_clean)|>
  mutate(index = 1:n())

# reg2_bivar
EB86_selected_clean_reg2_bivar <- EB86_selected_clean_reg2_bivar |> 
  dplyr::mutate(SRE1.96 = dplyr::case_when(
    .std.resid > 1.96 | .std.resid < -1.96  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -1.96 & .std.resid < 1.96 ~ 0
  ),
  SRE2.58 = dplyr::case_when(
    .std.resid > 2.58 | .std.resid < -2.58  ~ 1,
    .std.resid > -2.58 & .std.resid < 2.58 ~ 0
```

```{r}
# Function to calculate accuracy and percentage correct
calculate_percentage_correct <- function(model, data, cutoff = 0.5) {
  predicted_probs <- predict(model, type = "response")  # Predicted probabilities
  predicted_classes <- ifelse(predicted_probs > cutoff, 1, 0)  # Binary predictions
  actual_classes <- data$csdp_support  # Actual outcomes
  correct_predictions <- sum(predicted_classes == actual_classes, na.rm = TRUE)  # Correctly predicted
  sample_size <- sum(!is.na(actual_classes))  # Exclude NAs for sample size
  percentage_correct <- (correct_predictions / sample_size) * 100  # Percentage correct
  list(correct_predictions = correct_predictions, percentage_correct = percentage_correct)
}

# Calculate accuracy for each model
bivar_results <- calculate_percentage_correct(reg2_bivar, EB86_selected_clean)
controls_results <- calculate_percentage_correct(reg2_controls, EB86_selected_clean)
identity_results <- calculate_percentage_correct(reg2_identity, EB86_selected_clean)
identity_controls_results <- calculate_percentage_correct(reg2_identity_controls, EB86_selected_clean)
identity_fe_results <- calculate_percentage_correct(reg2_identity_fe, EB86_selected_clean)

# Display the results
cat("Correctly Predicted Cases and Percentages:\n")
cat("Bivariate Model: ", bivar_results$correct_predictions, "(", round(bivar_results$percentage_correct, 2), "%)\n")
cat("Controls Model: ", controls_results$correct_predictions, "(", round(controls_results$percentage_correct, 2), "%)\n")
cat("Identity Interaction Model: ", identity_results$correct_predictions, "(", round(identity_results$percentage_correct, 2), "%)\n")
cat("Identity Interaction with Controls Model: ", identity_controls_results$correct_predictions, "(", round(identity_controls_results$percentage_correct, 2), "%)\n")
cat("Fixed Effects Model: ", identity_fe_results$correct_predictions, "(", round(identity_fe_results$percentage_correct, 2), "%)\n")



# Function to calculate ROC and AUC for each model
calculate_auc <- function(model, data, model_name) {
  # Get predicted probabilities from the model
  predicted_probs <- predict(model, type = "response") 
  # Actual outcomes (the ground truth)
  actual_classes <- data$csdp_support  
  
  # Calculate ROC curve
  roc_curve <- roc(actual_classes, predicted_probs) 
  
  # Calculate AUC (Area Under the Curve)
  auc_value <- auc(roc_curve)
  
  # Plot the ROC curve
  plot(roc_curve, main = paste("ROC Curve for", model_name), col = "blue", lwd = 2)
  
  # Return the AUC value
  cat("AUC for", model_name, ":", auc_value, "\n")
  
  return(auc_value)
}

# Calculate and print AUC for each model
bivar_auc <- calculate_auc(reg2_bivar, EB86_selected_clean, "Bivariate Model")
controls_auc <- calculate_auc(reg2_controls, EB86_selected_clean, "Controls Model")
identity_auc <- calculate_auc(reg2_identity, EB86_selected_clean, "Identity Interaction Model")
identity_controls_auc <- calculate_auc(reg2_identity_controls, EB86_selected_clean, "Identity Interaction with Controls Model")
identity_fe_auc <- calculate_auc(reg2_identity_fe, EB86_selected_clean, "Fixed Effects Model")


# Make sure you have the predicted probabilities for each model
predict_bivar <- predict(reg2_bivar, type = "response")
predict_controls <- predict(reg2_controls, type = "response")
predict_identity <- predict(reg2_identity, type = "response")
predict_identity_controls <- predict(reg2_identity_controls, type = "response")
predict_identity_fe <- predict(reg2_identity_fe, type = "response")

# Actual outcomes
actual <- factor(EB86_selected_clean$csdp_support, levels = c(0, 1))  # 0 is negative, 1 is positive class

# Swap the classes to calculate PR AUC for class 0 (non-supporters)
roc_bivar_neg <- roc(actual, 1 - predict_bivar, levels = c(0, 1))  # Swap to focus on the negative class
roc_controls_neg <- roc(actual, 1 - predict_controls, levels = c(0, 1))
roc_identity_neg <- roc(actual, 1 - predict_identity, levels = c(0, 1))
roc_identity_controls_neg <- roc(actual, 1 - predict_identity_controls, levels = c(0, 1))
roc_identity_fe_neg <- roc(actual, 1 - predict_identity_fe, levels = c(0, 1))

# Print PR AUC for each model focused on the negative class
cat("PR AUC for Bivariate Model (negative class):", auc(roc_bivar_neg), "\n")
cat("PR AUC for Model with Controls (negative class):", auc(roc_controls_neg), "\n")
cat("PR AUC for Identity Model (negative class):", auc(roc_identity_neg), "\n")
cat("PR AUC for Identity Controls Model (negative class):", auc(roc_identity_controls_neg), "\n")
cat("PR AUC for Fixed Effects Model (negative class):", auc(roc_identity_fe_neg), "\n")
```
